predecessors.name: French Fifth Republic
predecessors.text: Madagascar, 'proclaimed on 14 October 1958, as an autonomous state within the French Community' and fully independent on 26 June 1960

ledger.x: 1960: Madagascar becomes fully independent from France.
1975: the First Republic gives way to the Marxist-Leninist Second Republic under Didier Ratsiraka.

certainty.note: An island: the coastline is the border.
